title: lane r2 QE: flaky detection and isolation unmechanized
description: Lane round 2. Lens: quality-engineer (validator: SE). Owner: SO session. Defect: single checkout-and-run cannot detect flakiness; isolation ('gates on the defect's test in isolation') has no verifying fixture. Citations verified: contract:64, :166, :173. Proposed: resolved-candidate, partially foldable (the gate runs the defect's named tests, not the whole suite — isolation by construction, recorded in the gate record; flake-resistance repetition policy set at phase-1c data authoring with the other numbers, same as the statusline timing instrument).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the gate runs the defect's named tests, not the whole suite — isolation by construction, in the gate record; flake-resistance repetition policy set at phase-1c data authoring with the other numbers. Revision: Phase exit by gate bullet.
